一个 Agent 通过同一账号连接 Mac、Linux 服务器和 VM: One agent connects to a Mac, Linux server, and VM through the same account
查询电脑，按任务选择环境: Discover computers and choose an environment
同一账号，统一查询与控制: One account to discover and control
一份云端 Prompt，接入你的多台电脑。: One cloud prompt connects your computers.
每台电脑运行 ReadyRig，通过 Google 登录绑定。: Run ReadyRig on each computer and link it with Google sign-in.
在设备控制台复制一次，交给你的 Agent。: Copy the prompt from the device console and give it to your agent.
按任务选择电脑: Choose a computer for the task
查询状态与连接，按你的要求开关工具和分享。: Check status and connections, then manage tools and sharing as you request.
把一次性公网接入信息交给朋友或协作者。他们的 Agent 就能调用你开放的工具，: Give a temporary public connection to a friend or collaborator. Their agent can use the tools you enable to work on your computer. Pause control or stop sharing locally or from your own device console.
同一个 Agent，使用不同电脑的环境。: One agent, working across your computers.
在工作 Mac 上处理资料与网页，在 Linux 服务器上运行构建，在 VM 中: Work with files and web pages on your Mac, run builds on a Linux server, and test in a VM. Link the same account so your agent can check their status and connections, then choose a target for your task.
在 Linux 服务器上运行 website 的测试，再用工作 Mac 的 Ch: Run the website tests on my Linux server, then check the site in Chrome on my work Mac. Return the results from each computer.
查询账号下的电脑与在线状态: List your account’s computers and check which are online
分别接入你指定的电脑，使用已开放的工具: Connect to the computers you choose and use their enabled tools
电脑需要保持在线并运行 ReadyRig。每台电脑的项目目录与权限分别设置。: Computers must stay online and run ReadyRig. Project folders and permissions are configured separately on each.
按任务使用不同电脑的资料与环境，也能把开放的工具临时分享给别人。: Use files and environments across your computers, or temporarily share enabled tools with others.
在 Gemini 等应用中填写 MCP 地址及下方生成的 Client ID 和: Enter the MCP URL and generated Client ID and Client secret in an app such as Gemini, then sign in to ReadyRig to authorize access.
云端 MCP 用于查询电脑、管理分享和工具权限。文件、终端及桌面操作通过各电脑返: Cloud MCP discovers computers and manages sharing and tool permissions. File, terminal and desktop operations use each computer’s returned connection URL.
Client secret 仅显示这一次，请保存。关闭后如遗失，需要撤销并重新创: The client secret is shown only once. Save it now. If lost after closing, revoke this client and create a new one.
从客户端的连接说明获取准确的回调地址，每行一个。必须完全匹配，不支持通配符。: Get the exact redirect URLs from your client’s connection instructions, one per line. Exact matches are required; wildcards are not supported.
授权最长保留 30 天，退出网页登录不会撤销。撤销后将立即停止此客户端的云端访问: Authorization lasts up to 30 days and survives website sign-out. Revoking immediately stops this client’s cloud access; turn off sharing to invalidate previously copied public links.
在 Gemini Spark 的 Connected Apps 中填写这个 MC: Enter this MCP URL in Gemini Spark’s Connected Apps, click Next, then sign in to ReadyRig to authorize. Automatic registration is supported; no manual Client ID or secret is needed.
连接后可查询电脑、管理分享，并调用已开启的文件、终端、浏览器和桌面工具。电脑需在: Once connected, discover computers, manage sharing and call enabled file, terminal, browser and desktop tools. Computers must be online with public sharing enabled. ReadyRig Cloud relays tool arguments and results.
自动注册 · 本账号已授权: Automatically registered · Authorized by this account
复制地址，登录授权，即可连接你的电脑。: Copy the address and sign in to connect your computers.
打开 Gemini Spark 的 Connected Apps: Open Connected Apps in Gemini Spark
粘贴 MCP 地址，点击 Next: Paste the MCP address and click Next
Client ID 和 secret 留空，系统会自动配置。: Leave Client ID and secret empty. Setup is automatic.
登录 ReadyRig 并确认授权: Sign in to ReadyRig and approve access
电脑需在线并开启公网分享。连接后，助手可调用你已开启的电脑工具。: Keep your computer online with public sharing enabled. Your assistant can use the computer tools you have enabled.
仅适用于要求填写 Client ID 和 secret 的客户端。Gemini: For clients that require a Client ID and secret. Use Quick connect for Gemini Spark.
可随时在授权管理中断开连接: Disconnect at any time in Manage access
请帮我在你当前使用的 AI 客户端中配置 ReadyRig MCP。\n\n服务:
Please configure the ReadyRig MCP server in the AI client you are currently using.

Server name: ReadyRig
MCP URL: {0}
Transport: Streamable HTTP
Authentication: OAuth with automatic discovery and dynamic client registration (DCR).

First check how this client configures MCP servers. If you can configure it, add this server while preserving other connections and avoiding duplicates. Use the client’s supported OAuth sign-in flow so I can sign in to ReadyRig in my browser and approve access; do not ask me to paste passwords, tokens, or a client secret into chat.

If you cannot change the configuration or the client does not support this connection, explain the limitation and provide specific setup steps for this client. With automatic registration, no manual Client ID or secret is needed; use ReadyRig’s Manual setup only if the client requires it.

After connecting, actually call list_computers to verify access and report the connection result and computer online status. Do not claim success just because the configuration was saved, and do not change computer permissions or public sharing settings during this setup.
让助手帮你配置: Let your assistant set it up
复制这段提示词，发送给你的 AI 助手。助手会配置连接，或指导你完成设置；登录授: Copy this prompt and send it to your AI assistant. It will configure the connection or guide you through setup. You’ll still confirm sign-in and access.
一部 99 秒的动画短片：ReadyRig 如何让云端 Agent 使用你的电脑: A 99-second animated film on how ReadyRig lets a cloud agent use your computer.
数据不经过 ReadyRig 服务器: Data does not pass through ReadyRig servers
在这台电脑的 ReadyRig 中开启。可作为直连链接失效时的备用，也可单独使用: Turn it on in ReadyRig on this computer. Use it as a backup for when the direct link stops working, or on its own.
直连链接正常时待命，不传数据。: On standby while the direct link works. No data is sent.
文件内容、命令输出和截图正经 ReadyRig 服务器转发。: File contents, command output and screenshots are being forwarded through ReadyRig servers.
MCP 地址（在 AI 应用中添加）: MCP address (add it in your AI app)
直连链接已开启 · 云端备用待命: Direct link on · Cloud backup on standby
直连链接未就绪 · 云端备用已连接: Direct link not ready · Cloud backup connected

此云端服务未开启云端转发: This cloud service does not offer cloud forwarding
设备凭证已失效，无法使用云端转发: Device credentials have expired, so cloud forwarding cannot be used
会先关闭云端转发，再开启直连链接。: Turns off cloud forwarding first, then starts the link.
